decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual speakers, excluding power cables and cases. My consideration set includes a mix of powerful outdoor options (comiso and TENMIYA), a reliable brand name (JBL), a rugged larger unit (Altec Lansing), and a highly-reviewed budget pick (LENRUE). I ultimately chose the comiso (prod_bluetooth_speakers_173) because it offers a high power output (30W), IPX7 waterproofing, and excellent battery life (24 hours) for a very reasonable price of $35.99. It strikes the best balance between performance specifications and value among the options.
